paper.title_en: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black holes from background subtraction
paper.abstract_en: The non-asymptotic flatness of the charged rotating black holes immersed in the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field causes the ambiguity in the gauge choice for the time generator and the electric potential. By using the newly established form of the integrability condition together with the gauge choice for the asymptotically flat charged rotating black holes as the initial condition, we have found that the gauge can be uniquely fixed. With this fixed gauge, we further obtain the mass and angular momentum by the background subtraction method with the Minkowski spacetime as the reference spacetime. As a result, not only is the first law of black hole thermodynamics as well as the quantum statistical relation automatically satisfied, but also both the Christodoulou-Ruffini relation and the Smarr formula are obeyed.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究非渐近平直时空中Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson黑洞的热力学，利用可积性条件与规范固定，通过背景减除法获得质量与角动量，并检验第一定律、Christodoulou-Ruffini关系与Smarr公式。属于黑洞热力学的核心议题，理论构造清晰，适合点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 背景减除法下Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson黑洞的热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 浸没在Bertotti-Robinson磁场中的带电旋转黑洞具有非渐近平直性，这导致时间生成元与电势的规范选择存在歧义。通过使用新建立的可积性条件形式，并以渐近平直带电旋转黑洞的规范选择作为初始条件，我们发现规范可以被唯一确定。在此固定规范下，我们进一步以Minkowski时空作为参考时空，通过背景减除法获得了质量和角动量。结果，不仅黑洞热力学第一定律以及量子统计关系自动得到满足，而且Christodoulou-Ruffini关系和Smarr公式也都成立。
